scriptLines: query: 'SELECT p.patient_id AS patient_id_bk, p.full_name AS nombre_completo, CASE p.gender WHEN \'Male\' THEN \'Masculino\' WHEN \'Female\' THEN \'Femenino\' ELSE \'Otro\' END AS genero, p.date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento, CASE WHEN a.edad IS NULL THEN \'Desconocido\' WHEN a.edad<=18 THEN \'0-18\' WHEN a.edad<=35 THEN \'19-35\' WHEN a.edad<=60 THEN \'36-60\' ELSE \'60+\' END AS rango_etario, p.email AS correo_electronico, p.address AS direccion, ISNULL(p.insurance_provider,\'Desconocido\') AS proveedor_seguro FROM silver.patients p CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN p.date_of_birth IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF(YEAR,p.date_of_birth,GETDATE()) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR,DATEDIFF(YEAR,p.date_of_birth,GETDATE()),p.date_of_birth)>CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS edad) a',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DELETE FROM gold.dim_paciente','DBCC CHECKIDENT (\'gold.dim_paciente\', RESEED, 0)'],
